phase_1.relative_strength: 63-session stock/benchmark log-return difference; average-tie percentile ranks in the liquid available universe; rank strictly above 80.
phase_1.sector_rotation: Top 3 of the complete manifest sector-index universe; worst rank for ties; no rank when any sector history is missing.
phase_1.breadth: Available-stock SMA50 breadth: above 60% full size; 40-60% half size; below 40% or under 90% valid coverage no new allocation.
phase_1.portfolio: At new entries: heat at most 6% of current NAV and the existing absolute risk cap; sector notional at most 25% NAV; pairwise absolute correlation strictly below 0.75 and the existing stricter limit, at least 30 paired daily observations. Existing position/count/cash limits also apply. Held positions are not forcibly sold.

phase_2.pead: Positive observed consensus EPS surprise with expectations captured before announcement, within existing 20-session freshness limit.
phase_2.earnings_momentum: Observed EPS growth above 20%, revenue growth above 15%, explicitly raised guidance, price above SMA200; fundamentals period-end age at most 150 calendar days and reporting period matching the earnings surprise.
phase_2.flow: Complete 20-session instrument-specific FII and DII net INR observations, observed delivery/turnover comparison, and volume expansion. Market aggregate flows cannot stand in for stock-level observations.
phase_2.composite: 30% relative-strength percentile, 25% earnings, 20% flow, 15% sector leadership, 10% candle structure; score strictly above 85/100. Missing required factors reject rather than receiving zero or silently changing weights. Phase 1 explicitly uses only RS/sector/structure, normalized over their frozen weights.

phase_3.regimes: High benchmark ATR expansion: ADX at least 35; low cross-sectional median ADX: range, disable breakout; benchmark above SMA200: bull ADX at least 20; otherwise bear ADX at least 30. Unknown ADX rejects.
phase_3.walk_forward: Rolling 5 calendar years of training, next calendar year of testing, disjoint test windows; partial last year labeled. Training results never choose alpha thresholds. Flat books and modeled liquidation at each test boundary.
phase_3.stress: 10,000 seeded circular-block trade bootstrap paths; additional slippage, gap loss and missed fills. Report drawdown, 95% loss VaR/expected shortfall and threshold-defined ruin probability. Trade-level approximation is not a concurrent daily portfolio simulation.

phase_4.meta: Opt-in standardized regularized logistic regression, global and per-regime cohorts. Only known closed training labels; 5-session embargo, chronological 80/20 split with overlapping labels purged, minimum 40 samples and 10 examples per class in fit split. No DATA_END training labels in walk-forward. Report holdout Brier score. Predictions are training estimates, not certified calibrated win probabilities; gate at 0.55.
phase_4.research: Dated local source packets for financials, results, promoter/institutional holdings, sector tailwinds and commentary. Optional explicitly configured Responses API call creates bull/bear theses, risks and catalysts; citations require exact quotes from supplied sources. Drafts require semantic review. No order authority.
phase_4.optimization: Deterministic alpha-rank constrained new-entry allocation against supplied held positions; replay enforces the same NAV/sector/heat/correlation limits against its simulated actual book. Scan allocations are indicative and exclude fees; replay includes modeled costs.

limitations: No external licensed feeds are acquired; unavailable evidence remains unavailable.
Current-snapshot membership is not point-in-time population coverage; survivorship and adjusted-price revision bias remain.
This new protocol does not change the frozen V1 or V2 prospective protocols.
Percentage limits are new-entry limits: subsequent marks may raise held exposures above them.
All thresholds and score recipes are research hypotheses, not proven sources of alpha.
No live trading strategy is promoted automatically.
